preview: An interview experience for a Summer Intern position at Citi detailing the PPT, AMCAT online test, technical interview, and HR interview.
content: Chirag Kathoye TY Information Technology Interview Experience For Summer Intern(2023) Table of Content 01) The PPT 02) Online Test 03) Interviews 04) Preparation 05) Tips 01) The PPT The mails were received by us on 13th of Sept 2022 after we registered to the program via TPO. It stated that the PPT would be conducted on 22nd Sept. The PPT was very conclusive and detailed. They explained everything about Citibank and what it does. However the stipend was not stated clearly in it. They explained the paper pattern and the platform on which the test would be conducted. Do attend the PPT as if you get selected you may have to face some HR questions which require the knowledge about the company and you won’t prefer to have that last minute hustle searching over for it on Google. 02) Online Test (11th Sept 2022 - 9 pm) The online test was conducted on the AMCAT platform that day. The login details were provided by them a day prior to the test. Do read the system requirements and the company mail carefully and then take the test. Duration of the test was 2hrs. The test consisted of 5 sections. Aptitude(16 Questions in 16 minutes), Logical reasoning(14 Questions in 14 minutes), Verbal ability(22 Questions in 18 minutes), Technical(25 Questions in 35 minutes) and Coding(2 Questions in 60 minutes). Each section was timed. The difficulty of the non-coding sections varied from easy to medium. The coding round was provided with a separate 1hr for 2 questions. Question 1] Trapezium Pattern printing The question in the AMCAT examination was a bit modified. The difference was that we needed to print “-” in the front spaces of trapezium. Suppose for input n = 4, the output goes as follows: Output : 1*2*3*4*17*18*19*20 –5*6*7*14*15*16 —-8*9*12*13 —---10*11 I was able to pass all the test cases (11/11) over here. Question 2] Maximum possible permutations possible of an array The question provided 2 inputs, the integer array and the size of the array. Our task was to calculate the maximum number of times we need to call the function which would provide all possible permutations which can be derived from the array. The problem at first seemed to be a bit tricky but had a very simple approach. We ultimately needed to find the maximum permutations which can be possibly generated in an array. Suppose we have an array of size 7. Then, the max number of permutations possible would be 7! And so on. This question also consisted of conditions where there were similar elements in the array. This could be taken care of by the Permutation with Repetition concept. Here I managed to pass (8/13) test cases. The result came out on 13th Sept and a total of 76 students were selected for the interviews. 03) Technical Interview (14th Sept) The Technical interview started by 9:30 am and was conducted online at a zoom meeting. The details of the meet and timings were provided a day prior only along with the shortlist List. My slot was at 12 pm. Each interview was expected to be of 30mins. My first interviewer was very kind and nice. The interview started with the basic question about ‘Tell me about yourself’. She also had my Resume so we went to the Resume section. She asked me to explain about my projects. I used the STAR approach to explain it. I had used ReactJs in one of my projects so she asked me a question about React. The question was like if i needed to access any particular method or element from any other file into my App.js, then what shall i do. I gave her the approach using ‘props’ as an argument. Then she asked me on a scale of 10 how would I rate myself in Java. I replied 6-6.5/10. Then she asked me about Typecasting. I was able to answer correctly. The next question was about OOPs. She asked me about what is a ‘class’. After this, she asked me to explain the Binary Search Algorithm. I explained the full method to her. But due to some connectivity issue from her side, she was not able to get the full thing. When she came back into the meeting she said that she was not able to hear anything due to connectivity loss and the time for the interview had exceeded. This was the moment which really got the spirit out of my body as I didn't feel that she was completely satisfied with the React answer so I thought I could really cover up that thing with Binary Search. But she politely said that she would be evaluating me on the basis of the questions asked prior. The whole time I was totally concerned about the results of the tech round cuz I thought I was in the pendulum state. The names were called on the roll out basis. I thought that maybe my name wouldn't come up for the second round and I almost had a sleep in that interval. But then surprisingly my name was called for the HR round at about 5:10pm while I just woke up at 5:05pm :) . A total of 32 students were selected further for the HR round. 04) HR Interview (14 Sept) After so much adventure during that period I rushed over my Laptop and got into the Formals again and joined the meet at 5:15pm. My second interviewer was also kind and generous. This interview also started with the ‘Tell me about yourself’ question. After that she asked me about my daily routine during college time. She then asked me about my hobbies. I told her about my hobbies and said that I used to love reading books prior but now prefer podcasts and audiobooks to save time though. She asked about one of my favorite books and what lessons that book taught me. Then she asked me about my Short term and Long term Goals which I had been planning. She also asked me about what I do when I experience a failure or I feel down at a point. Then she asked me what do I do if I am stuck due to a problem and how do I overcome it. The interview lasted about 15 min and was a very nice interaction between us. After the interviewer concluded my meeting and told me that the result would be announced shortly. The results came at about 10pm that day itself and a total of 15 students were shortlisted. I was fortunate enough to find myself over the List :) . 05) Preparation Have a good practice of DSA and always keep going through the concepts of DBMS, OOPs and OS. Choose a particular coding platform and try to solve questions on it on a targetive basis. 1) For DSA: Strivers SDE sheet, 450DSA 2) For Computer Concepts (OOPs): Love Babar Cheat Sheet, GFG 3) For DBMS: Love Babar DBMS, GFG , Gate Smashers Playlist, Last Minute notes of GFG 4) For OS: Gate Smashers, Last minute Notes on GFG 5) For Interview Questioning: InterviewBit and GFG Archives (Must view this section) 6) For Aptitude: Try to solve certain aptitude questions for fun to keep yourself brushed up with your concepts. You can try these with your friends too. 06) Tips 1) Be in a regular flow of solving coding questions. Because if you didn’t code for a while, it may happen that you would start forgetting some concepts. Be in the flow so that it would be easier for you for your coding questions. 2) Do read the GFG archives and the Prev year Internship Interview experiences by fail. These things help a lot. 3) Start your day with a positive vibe no matter what the result may come. This gives you a boost for your day. 4) Always try to stay calm and composed throughout your interview. Never panic or make yourself feel weak in front of the interviewer. Be confident. 5) If you are unable to answer any particular question then you can politely ask the interviewer to change the question. 6) Do revise the OOPs concepts, DBMS and OS for the interview preparations. 7) Try not to fake it in your resume. Because if she/he somehow finds a point where you have lied, it would create a bad impression of you in front of them. Be thorough with your projects and Resume. 8) Practice questions and try to take out notes of important concepts. 9) Have a group of your 3-4 good friends with whom you can discuss questions. This helps a lot as you may come to know about things which you may not have heard. 10) You can practice mock interviews on InterviewBit or even with Friends. This gives you confidence to answer to the interviewer. Have good communication with your friends as they play a vital role in your development too. 11) This would be the season of Internship drives and you may get stressed out as you see your friends getting into various companies. Try not to panic yourself in that period because if you mess up in that period you may lose many other opportunities. 12) Many times you may even face rejections in your various interviews and it takes the shit out of you in that period. Do not let it disturb your preparation and mind. 13) Last but not the least, plan your studies properly and Trust the process :) . Try contacting your seniors too and ask them what prep they did and what problems they faced in their time. Also ask them about their interview experience.
